verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developer page says a public API exists ("use our API directly to take full control of your workflow"), so the product does offer programmatic access, but nothing in the pack shows endpoints for listing mail items or downloading scan files. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at common paths, and no llms.txt or markdown docs, so the API's documentation and coverage are unproven. missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing mail items, documented scan/PDF download endpoint, published API reference or OpenAPI spec, authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list mail items and download scans through a documented public API — my systems ingest postal mail like any other data source

citations.quote: If that's not enough, use our API directly to take full control of your workflow.
Mail scanning, forwarding, and unlimited cloud storage.
